## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and implementation status are accurate.
- [ ] Related contracts, examples and documentation agree.
- [ ] Ownership, provenance, approval, versions and idempotency are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant normal and failure paths are verified.
- [ ] No credentials, real chats, session files or private screenshots.
- [ ] Migration/configuration changes are reproducible if applicable.
- [ ] Solo self-review recorded, or independent reviewer identified.
